items.definition:
an instrument for recording time with great accuracy, typically a stop-watch
His new watch has a built-in chronograph function.

a person who claims to have a supernatural ability to perceive events in the future or beyond normal sensory contact
The clairvoyant predicted a significant change in her life.

the act of committing a person or thing to a place or to the care of someone
The committal of the body took place at the cemetery.

activities designed to prevent an enemy from gaining secret information
The agency's counterintelligence efforts thwarted the spy's plans.

the process by which a substance forms into crystals
The crystallization of sugar occurs when the solution cools.

a common rock-forming mineral, a carbonate of calcium and magnesium
The Dolomites are a mountain range composed largely of dolomite rock.

the act of lengthening
The elongation of the metal rod was measured under stress.

a feeling of intense irritation or annoyance
He sighed in exasperation at the repeated delays.

a rigid external covering for the body in some invertebrate animals
Insects have a hard exoskeleton that protects their soft bodies.

the practice or art of choosing, cooking, and eating good food
Paris is renowned for its exquisite gastronomy.

a tip given to a service worker
It is customary to leave a gratuity for good service in restaurants.

a type of freshwater fish or butterfly
The angler hoped to catch a grayling in the clear mountain stream.

a swollen vein or mass of dilated veins in the region of the anus
The doctor prescribed cream to relieve the discomfort from the hemorrhoid.

a compound released in allergic reactions, causing dilation of capillaries and contraction of smooth muscle
Antihistamines block the effects of histamine, reducing allergy symptoms.

the current geological epoch, which began approximately 11,700 years ago
Human civilization developed during the Holocene epoch.

a literary or scientific institution; a public hall for lectures or concerts
The old building was once a grand lyceum.

X-ray examination of the breasts
Regular mammography screenings are crucial for early detection of breast cancer.

the ability to be maneuvered
The small car's excellent maneuverability made it easy to park in tight spaces.

a roundworm
Some nematodes are parasitic and can cause diseases in plants and animals.

natural development or consequence
The new policy was an outgrowth of the recent economic changes.

aristocrat
He came from a patrician family with a long history.

microscopic marine algae
Phytoplankton form the base of the marine food web.

type of pine tree
The forest was filled with tall ponderosa pines.

condition or stipulation
The agreement was accepted with the proviso that certain terms could be renegotiated.

process of becoming radical
The government is concerned about the radicalization of young people.

recovery from illness or exertion
She needed a long period of recuperation after the surgery.

act of reinventing
Her career has been marked by constant reinvention and adaptation.

real estate investment trust
Investing in a REIT can provide exposure to the real estate market without direct property ownership.

the formal rejection of something
His renunciation of the throne surprised everyone.

violation or misuse of what is regarded as sacred
Desecrating the ancient temple was considered an act of sacrilege.

a feeling of doubt or hesitation with regard to the morality or propriety of a course of action
He had no scruples about cheating on the test.

an amino acid
Serine is one of the non-essential amino acids.

the characteristic quality of a sound
The unique timbre of her voice made her stand out.

A circular pattern
She noticed the distinct whorl of his fingerprint.

Quality of deserving
He questioned his own worthiness to receive such an honor.

Long ago
In days of yore, knights roamed the land.

The act of making suffering less severe
The medicine provided some alleviation of her pain.

a feeling of being perplexed and confused
She stared at the complex instructions in utter bewilderment.

a rich fabric, typically silk, woven with a raised pattern
The queen wore a gown made of exquisite gold brocade.

the hard upper shell of a turtle, crustacean, or arachnid
The turtle retracted its head into its sturdy carapace.

a person falsely claiming to have a special knowledge or skill; a fraud
The self-proclaimed doctor was exposed as a charlatan.

a person who takes an opposing view, especially one who rejects the majority opinion
He's a contrarian by nature, always questioning popular beliefs.

an ornamental molding around the wall of a room just below the ceiling
The old building had an elaborate stone cornice.

the action or process of selecting, organizing, and looking after the items in a collection or exhibition
The museum is known for its excellent art curation.

the action of cutting off the head of a person or animal
The story described the brutal decapitation of the statue.

the action of stopping something
The company announced the discontinuation of the product line.

the action of cutting off the limbs of a person or animal
The old empire faced dismemberment after the war.

The belief that a system or society should be led by an elite.
The university was criticized for its perceived elitism.

A friendly understanding or informal alliance between states or factions.
The two nations formed a diplomatic entente.

A chronic disorder characterized by widespread musculoskeletal pain, fatigue, and tenderness in localized areas.
She was diagnosed with fibromyalgia after years of unexplained pain.

A soft, silvery-white metallic element.
Gallium is used in semiconductors.

A bridgelike framework, supported on side supports or legs, from which a crane or other equipment is suspended.
The gantry crane lifted the heavy container.

The branch of medicine concerned with the structure, functions, and diseases of the digestive system.
She decided to specialize in gastroenterology.

a sermon or a tedious moralizing lecture
The priest delivered a short homily on the importance of kindness.

the formation of ideas or concepts
The team engaged in a brainstorming session for new product ideation.

unfairness or injustice
The report highlighted the growing inequity in wealth distribution.

a person who advocates for a policy of remaining apart from the affairs or interests of other groups
The country adopted an isolationist foreign policy.

a cosmetic surgical procedure to remove fat
She considered liposuction to remove stubborn fat deposits.

the quality of being lyrical; an intense, expressive, and musical quality
The poet's work was praised for its profound lyricism.

an imaginary line dividing an object into two equal halves
The surgeon made an incision along the patient's midline.

the action or art of imitating someone or something
The chameleon's mimicry allows it to blend perfectly with its surroundings.

a bishop's hat; a type of joint in carpentry
The carpenter cut the wood at a perfect mitre angle.

a tiny piece of a substance
He noticed a tiny mote of dust dancing in the sunlight.

an inept or foolish person
Don't be such a nimrod; you just locked your keys in the car again.
